description: Compare a home-loan borrower's income tax under the OLD vs NEW regime (tax year 2026-27, Income-tax Act, 2025) and recommend which regime saves more income tax. Deterministic slab math — not tax advice. Use when the user asks "old or new tax regime", "home-loan tax benefit", or "section 80C / 24(b) deduction". Models interest (s.22, old 24(b)) + principal (s.123, old 80C); a joint loan is the user's own share. The response lists benefits it does NOT model. Includes a disclaimer field to show.

ageBand.description: Taxpayer age band — raises the OLD-regime basic exemption (senior 60–80 → ₹3L, super-senior 80+ → ₹5L). New regime unaffected. Defaults to below60.

annualIncome.description: Annual gross income in INR EXCLUDING house property (salary + other income).

annualRent.description: Annual rent received in INR for let_out (taken as 0 if omitted).

countryOfResidence.description: NRI only — DTAA article lookup hint. Free-form country name.

hasForm15CB.description: NRI only — whether Form 15CB CA-attestation is already in hand.

holdingMonths.description: NRI only — holding period in months. ≤24 is STCG; >24 is LTCG.

homeLoanPrincipal.description: Annual home-loan principal repaid (INR) — counts toward s.123 (old 80C).

indexedCost.description: NRI only — cost of acquisition (unindexed for an NRI). When omitted, TDS computed on full sale value.

isSalaried.description: Whether the taxpayer is salaried (gets the standard deduction).

jointLoan.description: Joint loan: amounts are the whole loan's; result is the user's own share (equal split).

nroBalanceUsd.description: NRI only — NRO account balance in USD equivalent for the repatriation cap math.

other80C.description: Other s.123 (old 80C) investments in INR (PF, ELSS, insurance, etc.).

otherOldRegimeDeductions.description: Other OLD-regime-only deductions as a lump (HRA exemption, 80D, NPS 80CCD(1B), etc.).

propertyType.description: Whether the property is self-occupied or let out.

residencyStatus.description: Default resident. Pass nri to get TDS (s.393(2), old §195) + LRS-cap math in the response.

saleValue.description: NRI only — sale consideration in INR for the TDS computation.

ytdRemittedUsd.description: NRI only — FY-to-date USD already remitted under the $1M cap.

title: Optimize home-loan tax regime (calculator)
